description: This file defines the RootTabs SwiftUI view, which manages a tab-based interface with three tabs: Screen, Voice, and Settings. It handles environment and state variables related to voice wake features, app status, and UI overlays, and contains UI logic including transitions, overlays, and actions triggered by user interactions and environment changes.

classes.name: RootTabs
classes.description: A SwiftUI view managing a tabbed interface with status overlays and voice wake notifications.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main UI layout, including tab views, overlays, and toast notifications, with state and environment bindings.

methods.name: gatewayStatus
methods.description: Computed property returning the current gateway status for display.

methods.name: statusActivity
methods.description: Computed property providing activity status information based on app model and voice wake state.
